candidate_identification.I_role: one complex electroweak doublet arising from the four SO(5)/SO(4) Goldstone coordinates
candidate_identification.so10_embedding: NONE_FROZEN; candidate is a lower-scale sector coupled to the SO(10) branch rather than an elementary GUT irrep
candidate_identification.reason_for_testing: The ordinary embedded doublet, ordinary linear internal-symmetry protection, and single-spurion GUT-scale pNGB branches are already FAIL. A lower-scale nonlinear sector remains an admitted REVIEW class.

reference_naturalness_bound.qualification: DERIVED reference bound from delta m^2 = C*alpha/(4*pi)*f^2. C=1 and alpha_reference are not representation-specific predictions.

ew_embedding_derivation.coset_goldstones: SO(5)/SO(4) has four Goldstone coordinates transforming as the SO(4) vector 4 ~= (2,2) of SU(2)_L x SU(2)_R
ew_embedding_derivation.I_identification: I is the complex Y=+1/2 doublet; the Y=-1/2 object is its conjugate charge partner, not an additional independent complex doublet
ew_embedding_derivation.scope_limit: This closes only the low-energy electroweak embedding. It does not derive an SO(10) embedding, UV strong sector, radiative protection, portal suppression, resonance spectrum, or backreaction on the frozen G422 running.

hard_falsifiers: FAIL if the derived radiative correction exceeds mu_I^2 without a symmetry-enforced or collective cancellation.
FAIL if an allowed SO(10)-sector portal regenerates an O(M_U^2) contribution to the I mass.
FAIL if required partner/resonance states invalidate the currently frozen gauge-running branch and no revised consistent running solution exists.
FAIL if the mechanism needs post-result parameter tuning comparable to the original hierarchy it was introduced to protect.
primary_mechanism_precedent: arXiv:hep-ph/0412089 (Agashe, Contino, Pomarol), Minimal Composite Higgs Model; SO(5)/SO(4) pNGB Higgs mechanism precedent only, not an FToE/SO(10) completion.
arXiv:0902.1483 (Gripaios, Pomarol, Riva, Serra), confirms the minimal SO(5)/SO(4) coset contains a unique Higgs doublet; mechanism precedent only.
epistemic_note: This file converts an abstract surviving mechanism class into a falsifiable candidate. The v0.2 change derives only the low-energy electroweak embedding. It does not close the protected-I sector, does not modify the frozen UV contract, and must not be read as evidence that the candidate is compatible with SO(10).
